transcript.statement: The requirements I propose ensure that the ATM system operates within ethical and regulatory frameworks. RES-01 guarantees compliance with financial regulations, while RES-02 ensures accountability through detailed transaction logs. RES-03 prevents negative balances, promoting fairness in financial transactions. RES-04 emphasizes secure user identification, enhancing accountability. RES-05 and RES-06 ensure responsible fund management and user notification, respectively. RES-07 protects user privacy, aligning with social responsibility. These requirements collectively uphold ethical standards in banking operations.

transcript.statement: The TrustworthinessAgent emphasizes the importance of security and privacy in the ATM system. TRU-01 ensures that all transactions are encrypted, protecting sensitive data during transmission. TRU-02 reinforces secure user authentication through a PIN mechanism, vital for access control. TRU-03 mandates logging transactions for auditability, while TRU-04 prevents negative balances, ensuring data integrity. TRU-05 allows users to securely review their transaction history, enhancing transparency. TRU-06 ensures users are notified of insufficient funds before transactions, preventing unauthorized actions. TRU-07 maintains data integrity by validating operations against business rules, crucial for trust in the system. These requirements collectively safeguard user data and uphold trust in banking operations.

transcript.statement: The GreenAgent emphasizes the importance of sustainability in the ATM system. GRN-02 provides transparency by reporting the carbon footprint of each transaction, promoting awareness. GRN-03 ensures the use of energy-efficient hardware, reducing resource consumption. requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account only when sufficient funds are available and with user consent.
The system shall notify users of insufficient funds before attempting a transaction.
The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The ATM system shall process transactions with slight flexibility in processing time during peak loads.
The ATM system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The ATM system shall integrate carbon footprint reporting with transaction logs.
The ATM system shall utilize energy-efficient processing during peak loads.
